name: merlonix
description: Live website and infrastructure monitoring for AI agents and answer engines. Check any public domain SSL/TLS certificate, DNS, and registration expiry; health-check and A-F security-grade any MCP server; score a site AI agent-readiness; check email blacklists; scan broken links; and read live status for 11 major cloud vendors. 8 public tools need no signup or API key; 8 account tools manage monitored assets and alerts.

http.description: Use the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (no install; public tools need no auth). Optional API key unlocks account tools.

npm.description: Run the stdio bridge locally (connects to the hosted API).

tools.name: check_domain_health
tools.description: Check the live SSL/TLS certificate (validity + expiry + issuer), DNS records (A/AAAA/MX/NS resolution), and domain-registration (RDAP) expiry of any public hostname. Each leg fails soft and is reported independently.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Score how ready a website is for AI agents and answer engines. Fetches /llms.txt, /robots.txt, and the homepage and returns a letter grade with per-signal findings. No browser rendering or LLM call — deterministic HTTP/parse.

tools.name: check_mcp_health
tools.description: Health-check a live MCP (Model Context Protocol) server by URL: performs a real JSON-RPC initialize handshake, then tools/list, and returns whether it is up/degraded/down, its protocol version, server name/version, the callable tool/resource/prompt inventory, transport, and handshake latency. Deterministic — no LLM. Use it to verify your own MCP server is alive and spec-compliant.

url.description: The MCP endpoint URL, e.g. https://example.com/mcp

tools.name: check_email_blacklist
tools.description: Check whether a domain or IP is listed on the major DNS blocklists (DNSBLs) that mail providers consult before accepting mail — the usual reason legitimate mail silently lands in spam. Returns each zone checked, whether it is listed, and the return code. Deterministic DNS lookups, no LLM.

domain.description: A public domain or IP address, e.g. example.com or 203.0.113.10

tools.name: check_broken_links
tools.description: Scan one web page for dead links (4xx/5xx/unreachable) and mixed content (http subresources on an https page). Returns each link with its status. Single-page scan, not a crawl — pass the exact page URL. Rate-limited to a few scans per minute, so batch calls will be throttled.

url.description: The exact page URL to scan, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

tools.name: list_vendor_status
tools.description: List the current operational status and recent incidents of every third-party vendor Merlonix monitors (e.g. Cloudflare, GitHub, Stripe). Returns each vendor's slug, current status, and 24h incident count.

tools.name: get_vendor_status
tools.description: Get the current status plus 30-day status history of one monitored vendor by slug (e.g. "cloudflare"). Use list_vendor_status to discover valid slugs.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List Merlonix subscription plans and pricing (Starter, Team, Agency, Compliance) with their monitoring limits.

tools.name: list_my_assets
tools.description: List the monitored assets (websites/domains) in YOUR Merlonix account. Returns each asset id, hostname, type, and monitoring status. Requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer mk_… from app.merlonix.com → Settings → API keys).

tools.name: get_asset_checks
tools.description: Get the latest check results (SSL, DNS, uptime, heartbeat, port) for ONE of your monitored assets, by its asset id (from list_my_assets). Requires an API key.

asset_id.description: The asset id from list_my_assets (a UUID).

tools.name: list_my_alerts
tools.description: List recent alerts across YOUR monitored assets (SSL changes, downtime, DNS drift, vendor incidents, etc.) with their severity and lifecycle status. Requires an API key.

tools.name: create_asset
tools.description: Start monitoring a new asset (website/domain) in YOUR Merlonix account. Provide a hostname and asset_type; optionally a label and which checks to enable. Returns the created asset. Requires an API key with write scope. Subject to your plan asset quota (a full or non-paying plan returns an error).

hostname.description: The hostname to monitor, e.g. example.com

ssl_enabled.description: Monitor the TLS certificate (default on for hostnames).

uptime_check_url.description: Optional URL to probe for uptime (enables uptime checks).

tools.name: update_asset
tools.description: Update one of YOUR monitored assets by its asset id (from list_my_assets): relabel it or toggle which checks run. Returns the updated asset. Requires an API key with write scope.

asset_id.description: The asset id from list_my_assets (a UUID).

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: STOP monitoring one of YOUR assets and remove it, by its asset id (from list_my_assets). This is irreversible — its check history goes too. Requires an API key with write scope.

asset_id.description: The asset id from list_my_assets (a UUID).

tools.name: acknowledge_alert
tools.description: Acknowledge one of YOUR alerts by its alert id (from list_my_alerts) — marks it as seen/being-handled without resolving it. Optionally attach a note. Requires an API key with write scope.

alert_id.description: The alert id from list_my_alerts (a UUID).

tools.name: resolve_alert
tools.description: Resolve one of YOUR alerts by its alert id (from list_my_alerts) — closes it. Optionally set resolution ("fixed" | "false_positive" | "wontfix") and a note. Requires an API key with write scope.

alert_id.description: The alert id from list_my_alerts (a UUID).

resolution.description: Why the alert is being closed.
